lead.headline: Rice leans out; Barkley still waits for Friday
lead.deck: Neither has practised. Tuesday's injury report reads Rice as likely out. Tuten's London kickoff still decides Barkley.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. You are 0-5, and your two best bench players still have not practised. Tuesday's NBC/Yahoo injury report reads Rashee Rice's hamstring as 'likely out' even though ESPN projects him at 14.4; Rapoport calls it relatively minor. That is why the flex call is a contingency: Rice in for Pickens only if active at 12:55 Sunday, because Pickens plays at night. Saquon Barkley is 'hopeful' and has 'a shot' pending practice, but Tuten kicks off at Wembley at 07:30, two hours before Barkley's inactives, so start Barkley only if Friday's report clears him. In Chicago, Caleb Williams has 'a pretty good chance' of returning, which keeps Loveland in the tight-end seat; if Bagent or Keenum is named instead, Strange is a free agent. Los Cachanillas project 79.2 with three starters on bye.
